needsBespoke.why: Headshot's stack-to-empower mechanic interacts with basic attacks in a way not fully captured by a single primitive: it is simultaneously a stacking counter (stacking-self-buff), the trigger for an empowered attack (empowered-attack), and its bonus damage term depends on the attacker's own crit chance/damage even on non-crit-rolled portions (crit-interaction) — the combination of stack-gating, only-base-portion-can-crit, and ability-granted bonus Headshots off W/E consuming a separate 'trapped' state needs bespoke sequencing logic to simulate correctly inside 15s (e.g., tracking attack count, brush assumption, and whether W/E procs are available).
